rust_summary: a mob's despawn check on the server (`native_mob_despawn`).
doc_summary: a mob's despawn check on the server: `native_mob_despawn(entity, kind, result)`, NeoForge's `MobDespawnEvent`, runs before vanilla's `Mob.checkDespawn` logic every tick for each loaded mob, persistent ones included (not the wither, which has its own check). Set `result` to `Some(true)` to despawn the mob, `Some(false)` to keep it, also in peaceful, or leave `None` for the default. It is a free function in `horizon_client::mobs::ai`, so it cannot call game helpers. Bundles need "hooks": @API:mob_despawn@.
